note: Reviewed results of automation_thirdparty_tests on Ubuntu (2026-10-05, LuaJIT with the Lua 5.2 extensions: L6-lua52-linux; SubInspector built for Linux: A33-subinspector-linux): load is ThirdPartyCorpus.ScriptsLoadAsAutoloadDoes per script, runs is ThirdPartyCorpus.MacrosApplyToTheFixtureDocument per run ("<script> | <macro>"). Paths read <stage>. Windows results were observed in the Windows VM (2026-10-14, job-a6dfbb66): they match these. AU5 (2026-11-11): HikariSub ships ILL's clipper2 wrapper, so ILL.SplitText, ILL.ChangeAlign and phos.RemoveTags load; their Windows results are expected to match and are confirmed by main CI. A platform not yet observed would be listed in unobserved_platforms; its results are recorded, not pinned. DependencyControl v0.9.1 with MoonScript 0.5.0 (DC1, 2026-10-27): its messages read [DepCtrl]; myaa.Bounce and arch.ConvertFolds now parse and load; lyger.FbfTransform and lyger.GradientEverything start without their first-run example preset (DC1-depctrl-fresh-config). FA4 (2026-11-02): all 14 arch1t3cht macros scripts have a run; the fixture gained a KFX template comment and a short Sign line whose outer quad is in [Aegisub Extradata], the runs see a 23.976 fps fixture video at frame 96 and the clipboard "fixture clipboard", events carry extra when a Line has values, and random_drawings lists runs whose drawings are random. AegisubChain's run is Manage Chains: its Configure fails with DependencyControl's ConfigView (ipairs on a config list), as in Aegisub 3.5.1.

loaded_only.myaa.MergeScripts.moon: DependencyControl tries to install its missing module myaa.pl (Myaamori's Penlight, not in this corpus) from the module's feed while the script loads, even with the updater off, so the reason it gives depends on the network; it fails to load either way.

macros_unordered.lyger.FbfTransform.moon: It registers one macro per preset by iterating its presets table with pairs(), whose order LuaJIT does not fix (string hashes are seeded per process), so the macros are pinned by name.
macros_unordered.lyger.GradientEverything.moon: Like lyger.FbfTransform, one macro per preset in pairs() order.

random_drawings.arch.FocusLines.moon | Focus Lines: draws its lines at random angles (math.random), so only the drawings are unpinned
